text: NDRMF is unique as a government-owned, Section 42, not-for-profit fund that operates with a corporate structure for agility while maintaining public accountability. It provides up to 70% co-financing grants to public and non-public entities, emphasizing ex-ante investments in planning, preparedness, mitigation, and early warning. It developed Pakistan's first national, probabilistic, multi-hazard catastrophe model with SUPARCO, and approved the first national Disaster Risk Financing Strategy in 2024, with a 10-year implementation roadmap.
